The cheapest five-star book in the Mystery category is **The Girl You Lost**, at **£12.29**.

The category has two pages, and I checked both. Five books are rated five stars:

| Title | Price |
|---|---|
| The Girl You Lost | £12.29 |
| The Silkworm (Cormoran Strike #2) | £23.05 |
| What Happened on Beale Street (Secrets of the South Mysteries #2) | £25.37 |
| A Time of Torment (Charlie Parker #14) | £48.35 |
| The Bachelor Girl's Guide to Murder (Herringford and Watts Mysteries #1) | £52.30 |

The browser tab is still open on page 2 of the category.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/mystery_3/index.html; agent-browser --session $S eval 'document.querySelector(".current")?.innerText'

cat <<'EOF' | agent-browser --session task-cdf484a85b26 eval --stdin
(async()=>{const out=[];for(const u of ["index.html","page-2.html"]){const t=await (await fetch("https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/mystery_3/"+u)).text();const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(t,"text/html");d.querySelectorAll("article.product_pod").forEach(a=>out.push([a.querySelector("p.star-rating").className,a.querySelector("h3 a").title,a.querySelector(".price_color").innerText]))}return out.filter(r=>r[0].includes("Five"))})()
EOF
